findings.message: property package 'Peng-Robinson (PR)' is a substitution for Peng-Robinson with Wong-Sandler mixing rules (loses: the Wong-Sandler (excess Gibbs energy) mixing rules; classical one-fluid mixing with kij); accepted: Peng-Robinson for an air separation unit: the cryogenic part (N2, O2, Ar, where the column and exchanger results matter) is non-polar, and the polar water is only in the warm end, at most 3.4 mol%, removed as near-pure condensate and in the TSA. Known limitation: PR gives water at saturation 10-13 % low (D-058); the adsorbers are sized on the IAPWS-95 water load (D-080). Proposed by the agent in D-097. Accepted (D-103) by the agent on the owner's delegation of 2026-10-25, not as the owner's own judgement: PR with the D-066 Ar/O2 kij is suitable for N2/O2/Ar vapour-liquid equilibrium at these conditions (1.3-5.5 bara, 80-100 K), and water appears only at the warm end and in the condensates, where the duties are small. The limitation stays listed.

cases.description: Design case: the D-099 design air (30 C, 80 % RH, 1.013 bara, 85,840 Nm3/h dry; design specification), ~83 % O2 recovery (D-066, ASSUMED)

design_basis: ASSUMED O2 recovery ~83 % (D-066: no argon column, 99.5 % purity, GAN drawn from the HP column (13 % of the HP column air), 13 % Lachmann air; was 94 %, which the simulated double column does not reach).
ASSUMED MAC discharge 5.8 bara, HP column top 5.4 bara, LP column top 1.3 bara.
ASSUMED refrigeration by booster-braked expander, Lachmann air to the LP column, ~11,500 Nm3/h, ~198 kW (D-061); the boosted air enters the main exchanger at 15 C (D-067).
ASSUMED regeneration gas ~14,600 Nm3/h waste N2 (D-066), heated electrically to 200 C.

ASSUMED DCAC air outlet 12 C via chilled water from an N2 evaporative cooler; no mechanical chiller. All waste N2 not used for regeneration goes to the evaporative cooler; its chilled water also trims the booster air to 15 C (D-067).
ASSUMED GAN taken as pressurized N2 from the HP column top (~5.2 bara) and compressed to 9 bara.
ASSUMED all flows, pressures, duties and DNs are concept estimates, accuracy about +/-30 %.
